name: University of Toronto
summary: Founded 1827, with about 81,000 undergraduates across three campuses in the Toronto area and more than 700 programs.

ib.text: IB Diploma with English HL or SL; prerequisites at SL or HL; bonus points are not counted. Engineering asks a predicted 30 with 4+ in prerequisites; UTM a predicted 27+ for a provisional offer.

dates.label: Documents, to be considered with the first offers
Application deadline (all full-time programs except Medical Radiation Sciences)

programmes.name: Computer Science (St. George)
programmes.about: Computer Science in the Faculty of Arts & Science at the downtown St. George campus, as a Major or Specialist (BCS) or a Minor within an HBSc, with work-integrated learning available.
programmes.ib: A supplemental application is required; calculus-level maths (Maths AA SL or HL, or AI HL) and English are prerequisites.

needs.note: Calculus and Advanced Functions; AI SL covers only Advanced Functions

programmes.selectionNote: Admission is on predicted or final IB results without bonus points, plus a supplemental application. Apply early; competitive programs ask for more than the minimum.

flagshipSource.title: Department of Computer Science: research areas, from machine learning and AI to graphics and theory

programmes.name: Engineering Science
programmes.about: Two foundation years in engineering, maths, science, computing and design, then eight majors for the last two years. Research runs through the degree, in contrast to the eight direct-entry engineering disciplines.
programmes.ib: Predicted 30 minimum (excluding ToK and EE), 4+ in each prerequisite; Maths AA HL strongly recommended. No advanced standing for IB.

needs.note: Maths AA HL is strongly recommended

programmes.selectionNote: Marks and subjects are weighed with the mandatory Online Student Profile and an engineering supplemental application (fee CAD 69). Apply early.

flagshipSource.title: A little EngSci history: the program's origins and development in the Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts & Science (St. George)
faculties.line: Calculus is required for most math, science, computer science and commerce programs; Maths AI SL meets only Advanced Functions.

faculties.name: Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering
faculties.line: Predicted 30 minimum; Maths, Physics, Chemistry and English at 4+; an Online Student Profile; no advanced standing for IB.

faculties.name: University of Toronto Mississauga
faculties.line: A predicted 27 or more for a provisional offer; HL 5+ earns up to 3.0 transfer credits, SL none.

faculties.name: University of Toronto Scarborough
faculties.line: HL grades of 5 or more earn transfer credit, up to 3.0 credits in all; SL earns none.

notes: International tuition for 2027/28 is set in the spring of the year; the international figure is not published yet.
Bonus points (ToK and EE) are excluded when U of T reads predicted or final IB results.
Final IB results must be sent to U of T electronically by the IBO.
